parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a ceramic pot, made of porcelain. It is circular and slightly domed with a small handle on top.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the container to protect its contents from dust, moisture, or contamination. It can be lifted or placed manually.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or placed on top of the container; it does not have any mechanical movement.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pot, made of porcelain. It has a rounded shape with a narrow neck and wide base.
parts.Functional_description: The container holds liquids, grains, or decorative items. It provides the main storage volume of the pot.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static part and does not move; it supports the lid and contains the stored material.
